rule.text: I call my grandmother every Friday.
I block out Wednesday morning for our team meeting.
I'm hosting a friend who eats dairy-free this weekend.
Everything I jot down goes into Logseq.
I need a quick pep talk.
The farmers market in my neighborhood in Seattle opens again this weekend.
Please only suggest gluten-free recipes for me.
I've changed note apps, and I use Evernote now.
My manager changed this week, and it's Dana Gallowglass now.
I no longer live in Seattle; I moved to Atlanta.
I'm not gluten-free anymore; I'm vegetarian now.
Help me think through my schedule.
Our weekly team meeting moved to Tuesday.
I could use some help organizing my to-do list.
I'm trying to drink less coffee.
My best friend just bought a house in Phoenix.
